result_code.description: Distinct terminal codes. 'declined' means the person refused to talk and is never counted as evidence; 'voicemail' and 'wrong_person' are separate terminal states; 'advisory_needs_review' carries a keyword-derived summary that a human must confirm and never dispatches on its own; 'halted_safe' is the fail-closed catch-all.

structured_result.description: Confidence gate: must be null when confidence is below threshold or the call was declined.

assessment_basis.description: Where structured_result came from. 'model_structured' is bound to the declared result schema and may drive routing. 'heuristic_advisory' is keyword matching over the transcript summary: advisory only, always needs_human, never dispatched automatically. 'none' when there is no structured result.

evidence.description: Per-utterance evidence. 'declined' and 'no_answer' must not produce content-bearing evidence.

handoff_context.description: Contains only the fields allowlisted in input.handoff_context.
